cow.example: Cows give us fresh and nutritious milk.
cow.exampleZh: 乳牛提供我們新鮮有營養的牛奶。

sheep.example: The white sheep are grazing on the green hill.
sheep.exampleZh: 白色的綿羊正在綠色山丘上吃草。

duck.example: Yellow ducks are swimming happily in the pond.
duck.exampleZh: 黃色鴨子在池塘裡高興地游泳。

chicken.example: We had fried chicken and salad for lunch.
chicken.exampleZh: 我們午餐吃了炸雞和沙拉。

mouse.example: The mouse ran quickly into the hole.
mouse.exampleZh: 老鼠迅速地跑進洞穴裡。

frog.example: The green frog jumped into the cool water.
frog.exampleZh: 綠色青蛙跳進了涼爽的水中。

turtle.example: Sea turtles lay their eggs on sandy beaches.

snake.example: Be careful; there might be snakes in the bush.
snake.exampleZh: 小心點，灌木叢中可能會有蛇。
snake.memoryTip: Magic E 使 a 發 /eɪ/

bee.example: Bees collect nectar from colorful flowers.
bee.exampleZh: 蜜蜂從鮮豔的花朵中採集花蜜。

butterfly.example: A colorful butterfly landed gently on the rose.
butterfly.exampleZh: 一隻五彩斑斕的蝴蝶輕輕停在玫瑰上。

egg.example: Eating an egg every day provides good protein.
egg.exampleZh: 每天吃一顆蛋能提供優質蛋白質。

soup.example: Mom made a pot of hot chicken soup for us.
soup.exampleZh: 媽媽為我們煮了一鍋熱雞湯。

salad.example: She ordered a fresh vegetable salad with dressing.
salad.exampleZh: 她點了一份淋上醬汁的新鮮蔬菜沙拉。

potato.example: Baked potatoes are delicious with a little butter.
potato.exampleZh: 烤馬鈴薯加上一點奶油非常美味。

tomato.example: Fresh red tomatoes are great for making pasta sauce.
tomato.exampleZh: 新鮮紅番茄非常適合拿來做義大利麵醬汁。

cake.example: We blew out the candles on the birthday cake.
cake.exampleZh: 我們吹熄了生日蛋糕上的蠟燭。
cake.memoryTip: Magic E 使 a 發長音 /eɪ/

cookie.example: Grandma baked warm chocolate chip cookies for us.
cookie.exampleZh: 奶奶為我們烤了熱騰騰的巧克力餅乾。

ice cream.example: Eating cold ice cream on a hot summer day is wonderful.
ice cream.exampleZh: 在炎熱夏天吃冰涼的冰淇淋真是太棒了。

pizza.example: We shared a large cheese pizza with our classmates.
pizza.exampleZh: 我們和同班同學分享了一個大起司披薩。

shirt.example: Dad wears a clean white shirt to work every day.
shirt.exampleZh: 爸爸每天穿著乾淨的白襯衫上班。

pants.example: He bought a new pair of black pants for the concert.
pants.exampleZh: 他為音樂會買了一條新的黑長褲。

dress.example: She wore a lovely blue dress to the party.
dress.exampleZh: 她穿著一件優雅的藍色洋裝去參加宴會。

coat.example: Put on your warm coat because it is freezing outside.
coat.exampleZh: 穿上你的暖大衣，因為外面很寒冷。

jacket.example: He zipped up his warm jacket before going outdoors.
jacket.exampleZh: 出門前他拉上了保暖夾克的拉鍊。

shoes.example: Take off your muddy shoes before entering the house.
shoes.exampleZh: 進屋前請脫掉沾滿泥巴的鞋子。

hat.example: She wore a straw hat to protect her face from the sun.
hat.exampleZh: 她戴了一頂草帽來遮陽。

home.example: After school, the students were eager to go home.
home.exampleZh: 放學後學生們迫不及待地想回家。
home.memoryTip: Magic E 使 o 發長音 /oʊ/

house.example: They live in a beautiful house with a green garden.
house.exampleZh: 他們住在一棟帶有綠色花園的美麗房子裡。

room.example: Keep your study room neat and well organized.
room.exampleZh: 保持你的書房整齊又有條理。

door.example: Please close the door quietly so as not to wake the baby.
door.exampleZh: 請輕輕關上門以免吵醒小寶寶。

window.example: Open the window to let fresh morning air in.
window.exampleZh: 打開窗戶讓早晨的新鮮空氣進來。

table.example: Help Mom set the table before dinner starts.
table.exampleZh: 在晚餐開始前幫媽媽擺好餐具。

bed.example: Children should go to bed early and get up early.

city.example: Taipei is a bustling and convenient modern city.
city.exampleZh: 台北是一座繁華且便利的現代城市。
city.memoryTip: c 在 i 前發軟音 /s/

park.example: Families like to picnic in the central park on Sundays.
park.exampleZh: 家庭喜歡在週日去中央公園野餐。

hospital.example: The ambulance rushed the injured patient to the hospital.
hospital.exampleZh: 救護車將受傷的病患迅速送往醫院。

store.example: You can buy snacks at the 24-hour convenience store.
store.exampleZh: 你可以在二十四小時便利商店買點心。

bus.example: Taking a bus is an eco-friendly way to travel around.
bus.exampleZh: 搭乘公車是環遊市區的環保方式。

train.example: The train arrived at the station right on schedule.
train.exampleZh: 火車非常準時地抵達了車站。

car.example: Dad bought a fuel-efficient electric car last month.
car.exampleZh: 爸爸上個月買了一輛節能的電動汽車。

beach.example: We collected colorful seashells on the sandy beach.
beach.exampleZh: 我們在沙灘上收集五顏六色的貝殼。

mountain.example: Jade Mountain is the highest peak in Taiwan.

river.example: A long concrete bridge stretches across the river.
river.exampleZh: 一座長長的混凝土橋跨越了這條河。

lake.example: Sun Moon Lake attracts tourists from all over the world.
lake.exampleZh: 日月潭吸引了來自世界各地的遊客。
lake.memoryTip: Magic E 使 a 發長音 /eɪ/

sea.example: They spent a relaxing summer holiday by the sea.
sea.exampleZh: 他們在海邊度過了一個放鬆的暑假。

ocean.example: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
ocean.exampleZh: 太平洋是地球上最大的海洋。
ocean.memoryTip: o 開音節 /oʊ/ + cean 發 /ʃən/

tree.example: Big trees provide cool shade during the summer.
tree.exampleZh: 大樹在夏天提供涼爽的樹蔭。

flower.example: Spring is a wonderful season when sweet flowers bloom.
flower.exampleZh: 春天是芬芳花朵盛開的美好季節。

grass.example: Please do not step on the fresh green grass.

garden.example: Grandpa grows colorful roses in his front garden.
garden.exampleZh: 爺爺在他前院的花園裡種植繽紛的玫瑰。

sky.example: A colorful rainbow appeared across the bright blue sky.
sky.exampleZh: 一道七彩彩虹出現在湛藍的天空中。
sky.memoryTip: 單音節結尾 y 發長雙母音 /aɪ/

sun.example: The sun gives us light and warmth every single day.
sun.exampleZh: 太陽每天都給予我們光和熱。

moon.example: Families gather to admire the full moon on Mid-Autumn Festival.
moon.exampleZh: 中秋節時闔家團圓一同賞滿月。

star.example: You can see millions of stars in the countryside sky.
star.exampleZh: 在鄉村的夜空中你能看見千萬顆星星。

rainbow.example: A brilliant rainbow appeared after the sudden shower.
rainbow.exampleZh: 陣雨過後出現了一道絢爛的彩虹。

clock.example: The alarm clock rings loudly at six thirty.
clock.exampleZh: 鬧鐘在六點半大聲響起。

lamp.example: Turn on the desk lamp when you read in the evening.
lamp.exampleZh: 晚上讀書時請打開檯燈。

sofa.example: Dad likes to relax on the comfortable sofa after work.
sofa.exampleZh: 爸爸下班後喜歡在舒適的沙發上放鬆。

computer.example: Students use the computer to look up research data.
computer.exampleZh: 學生們使用電腦查詢研究資料。

box.example: She opened the mysterious box with great excitement.
box.exampleZh: 她懷著無比興奮的心情打開神秘盒子。

bag.example: Bring your own reusable cloth bag when shopping.
bag.exampleZh: 購物時請自備可重複使用的布袋。

cup.example: Would you like a cup of hot green tea?

glass.example: He drank a large glass of cold water after jogging.
glass.exampleZh: 他慢跑後喝了一大杯冰水。

bottle.example: Remember to bring your water bottle to sports class.
bottle.exampleZh: 上體育課時記得帶上你的水壺。

big.example: An elephant is a very big land animal.
big.exampleZh: 大象是一種體型非常龐大的陸地動物。
big.memoryTip: CVC 結構，比較級雙寫 g：bigger

small.example: A small mouse slipped into the pantry quietly.
small.exampleZh: 一隻小老鼠悄悄溜進了食品儲藏室。

tall.example: Taipei 101 is one of the tallest towers in Asia.
tall.exampleZh: 台北 101 是亞洲最高的高塔之一。

short.example: He wrote a humorous short story for English class.
short.exampleZh: 他為英文課寫了一篇幽默的短篇故事。

long.example: Summer vacation is a long and wonderful holiday.
long.exampleZh: 暑假是一段漫長而美好的假期。

fast.example: Cheetahs can run exceptionally fast across grasslands.
fast.exampleZh: 獵豹能在草原上以極快速度奔馳。

slow.example: Turtles walk with slow and steady steps.
slow.exampleZh: 烏龜邁著緩慢而穩健的步伐行走。

hot.example: Be careful because the hot soup might burn your tongue.
hot.exampleZh: 請小心，熱湯可能會燙傷你的舌頭。
hot.memoryTip: CVC 結構，比較級雙寫 t：hotter

cold.example: Drinking ice-cold juice is refreshing in summer.
cold.exampleZh: 夏天喝冰涼果汁令人心曠神怡。

new.example: I wore my new shoes to school for the first time.
new.exampleZh: 我第一次穿新鞋去上學。

old.example: Meeting an old friend brings back happy memories.
old.exampleZh: 遇見老朋友會喚起美好的回憶。

young.example: Young children learn languages very quickly.
young.exampleZh: 幼童學習語言非常快速。

busy.example: Dad had a very busy and productive day at work.
busy.exampleZh: 爸爸在工作上度過了非常忙碌且充實的一天。

easy.example: This English question is quite easy to answer.
easy.exampleZh: 這道英文題目相當容易回答。

hard.example: If you study hard, you will achieve your goals.
hard.exampleZh: 如果你努力學習，你一定能達成目標。

sweet.example: These red apples taste delightfully sweet.
sweet.exampleZh: 這些紅蘋果嘗起來非常甘甜可口。

choose.example: You have to choose one option from the four choices.
choose.exampleZh: 你必須從四個選項中挑選一個。

freeze.example: Water freezes into ice at zero degrees Celsius.
freeze.exampleZh: 水在攝氏零度時會結成冰。

rise.zh: 上升、升起 (三態 rise-rose-risen，不及物)
rise.example: The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
rise.exampleZh: 太陽從東方升起，從西方落下。
rise.memoryTip: 不及物動詞！不接受詞。三態：rise ➔ rose ➔ risen

raise.zh: 舉起、撫養、籌募 (及物動詞)
raise.example: Please raise your hand if you have any questions.
raise.exampleZh: 如果你有任何問題，請舉手。
raise.memoryTip: 及物動詞！後方必接名詞受詞。規則變化：raise-raised-raised

lead.zh: 引導、帶領、導致 (三態 lead-led-led)
lead.example: Hard work and dedication will lead to great success.
lead.exampleZh: 努力與投入將會引導走向巨大的成功。
lead.memoryTip: 三態：lead ➔ led ➔ led。注意 lead to 常考片語！

spread.zh: 傳播、蔓延 (三態同形 spread-spread-spread)
spread.example: False news can spread very quickly across the internet.
spread.exampleZh: 假消息在網路上傳播得非常快速。
spread.memoryTip: 三態同形：spread ➔ spread ➔ spread，ea 發短母音 /ɛ/

grow.example: Vegetables grow very well in this fertile soil.
grow.exampleZh: 蔬菜在這片肥沃的土壤中生長得非常好。

hide.example: The little cat hid under the sofa during the thunderstorm.
hide.exampleZh: 在雷雨期間，小貓躲在沙發底下。

steal.example: The thief stole a bicycle from outside the store.
steal.exampleZh: 小偷從店門口偷走了一輛腳踏車。

shake.example: They shook hands politely after concluding the deal.
shake.exampleZh: 達成協議後，他們禮貌地握了手。

break.example: Never break safety rules in the laboratory.
break.exampleZh: 在實驗室裡切勿違反安全守則。
break.memoryTip: 三態：break ➔ broke ➔ broken，ea 發長音 /eɪ/

bring.example: Remember to bring your textbook to class tomorrow.
bring.exampleZh: 記得明天上課要把課本帶來。

buy.example: She bought a birthday present for her best friend.
buy.exampleZh: 她為她最好的朋友買了一份生日禮物。

catch.example: Hurry up, or we will not be able to catch the last bus.
catch.exampleZh: 快一點，否則我們會趕不上末班公車。

drive.example: Always drive carefully in rainy or snowy conditions.
drive.exampleZh: 在雨雪天候中行車務必小心謹慎。

fall.example: Leaves fall from trees when autumn arrives.
fall.exampleZh: 秋天來臨時樹葉自枝頭飄落。

feel.zh: 感覺、覺得 (連綴動詞，三態 feel-felt-felt)
feel.example: I felt very excited when I received the acceptance letter.
feel.exampleZh: 收到錄取通知時我感到無比興奮。
feel.memoryTip: 連綴動詞！後接形容詞補語。三態：feel ➔ felt ➔ felt

find.example: Did you find out what caused the unexpected power outage?
find.exampleZh: 你有查出是什麼原因導致這場突發停電嗎？

forget.example: Don't forget to lock the front door before leaving.
forget.exampleZh: 出門前別忘記鎖上大門。
forget.memoryTip: forget to V (忘記去做) vs forget V-ing (忘記曾做過)

give.example: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how tough it gets.
give.exampleZh: 無論多麼艱辛，絕不要放棄你的夢想。

hear.zh: 聽見 (感官動詞，三態 hear-heard-heard)
hear.example: I heard someone calling my name outside the window.
hear.exampleZh: 我聽見有人在窗外喊我的名字。
hear.memoryTip: 感官動詞！受詞後接原形動詞或 V-ing。三態：hear ➔ heard /hɝːd/

hold.example: The student council will hold a charity sale next Friday.
hold.exampleZh: 學生會下週五將舉辦一場慈善義賣。

keep.example: Keep practicing every day and your English will improve.
keep.exampleZh: 持續每天練習，你的英文一定會進步。
keep.memoryTip: keep + V-ing 表持續動作。三態：keep ➔ kept ➔ kept

know.example: I didn't know that she could speak three languages.
know.exampleZh: 我以前不知道她竟然能說三種語言。
know.memoryTip: k 不發音！三態：know ➔ knew /nuː/ ➔ known /noʊn/

leave.example: The bullet train leaves for Kaohsiung at eight thirty.
leave.exampleZh: 高鐵於八點半開往高雄。

lose.example: Be careful not to lose your passport when traveling.
lose.exampleZh: 旅行時務必小心不要遺失你的護照。
lose.memoryTip: 三態：lose ➔ lost ➔ lost。注意與 loose /luːs/ (鬆的) 區分！

meet.example: We decided to meet in front of the subway station.
meet.exampleZh: 我們決定在捷運站前面碰面。

pay.example: Pay close attention to what the teacher is explaining.
pay.exampleZh: 密切注意老師正在說明的內容。
pay.memoryTip: 三態：pay ➔ paid ➔ paid。注意 pay attention to 核心片語！

ride.example: He rides his bicycle to the sports center every weekend.
ride.exampleZh: 他每週末都騎腳踏車去運動中心。

see.zh: 看見 (感官動詞，三態 see-saw-seen)
see.example: Did you see what happened at the corner of the street?
see.exampleZh: 你有看見街角發生了什麼事嗎？
see.memoryTip: 感官動詞！受詞後接原形動詞或 V-ing。三態：see ➔ saw /sɔː/ ➔ seen

send.example: I will send you the detailed schedule by email today.
send.exampleZh: 我今天會透過電子郵件寄給你詳細時程表。

sing.example: The choir sang beautiful carols at the celebration.
sing.exampleZh: 合唱團在慶祝活動中唱出了優美的頌歌。

sit.example: Please sit down and make yourself comfortable.

spend.zh: 花費（時間/金錢）(三態 spend-spent-spent)
spend.example: She spends two hours studying English every evening.
spend.exampleZh: 她每天晚上花兩小時研讀英文。
spend.memoryTip: 主詞必為人！人 + spend + 時間/金錢 + (on N / V-ing)

stand.example: Passengers must stand behind the yellow safety line.
stand.exampleZh: 乘客必須站在黃色安全線後方。

swim.example: He swam across the lake during the summer competition.
swim.exampleZh: 他在夏季賽事中游過了整座湖泊。

take.zh: 拿取、花費（時間）(三態 take-took-taken)
take.example: It took me three days to finish writing the essay.
take.exampleZh: 寫完這篇論文花了我三天的時間。
take.memoryTip: 虛主詞 it 表花費時間：It takes (人) + 時間 + to V

teach.example: Mr. Davis has taught mathematics for over twenty years.
teach.exampleZh: 戴維斯老師教授數學已經超過二十年了。

tell.example: Can you tell me the difference between these two words?
tell.exampleZh: 你能告訴我這兩個單字之間的差異嗎？
tell.memoryTip: 授與動詞：tell + 人 + 事物。三態：tell ➔ told ➔ told

think.example: Take a few minutes to think carefully about the plan.
think.exampleZh: 花幾分鐘仔細思考一下這項計畫。

throw.example: The pitcher threw the baseball with tremendous speed.
throw.exampleZh: 投手以驚人的球速投出了棒球。

wear.example: People wear face masks on public transport to stay safe.
wear.exampleZh: 人們在大眾運輸上戴口罩以確保安全。

win.example: Our basketball team won the championship yesterday.
win.exampleZh: 我們的籃球隊昨天贏得了總冠軍。

technology.example: Modern technology makes communication across borders instant.
technology.exampleZh: 現代科技使得跨國溝通變得即時迅捷。

internet.example: Students search for reference materials on the internet.
internet.exampleZh: 學生們在網際網路上搜尋參考資料。

smartphone.example: Do not look at your smartphone screen while walking.
smartphone.exampleZh: 走路時請不要盯著智慧型手機螢幕看。

software.example: You need to update your antivirus software regularly.
software.exampleZh: 你需要定期更新你的防毒軟體。
software.memoryTip: soft (軟) + ware (製品)，不可數名詞！

device.example: Turn off all electronic devices during the airplane takeoff.
device.exampleZh: 飛機起飛期間請關閉所有電子裝置。

application.example: This learning application helps students practice English listening.
application.exampleZh: 這款學習應用程式能幫助學生練習英語聽力。

connect.example: My tablet cannot connect to the school wireless network.
connect.exampleZh: 我的平板無法連上學校的無線網路。

information.example: The official website provides reliable information for tourists.
information.exampleZh: 官方網站為遊客提供可靠的旅遊資訊。
information.memoryTip: 注意：information 在英文中恆為不可數名詞！

online.example: Many students take online English courses during holidays.
online.exampleZh: 許多學生在假期期間參加線上英語課程。

digital.example: We live in a digital age where information spreads instantly.
digital.exampleZh: 我們生活在一個資訊即時傳播的數位時代。

environment.example: We should reduce plastic waste to protect the environment.
environment.exampleZh: 我們應該減少塑膠垃圾以保護環境。

pollution.example: Air pollution has become a serious issue in big cities.
pollution.exampleZh: 空氣污染已經成為大城市中的嚴重問題。

recycle.example: Our school encourages all students to recycle plastic bottles.
recycle.exampleZh: 我們學校鼓勵所有學生回收寶特瓶。
recycle.memoryTip: re- (再) + cycle (循環) ➔ 資源回收

climate.example: Global climate change causes more frequent extreme weather events.
climate.exampleZh: 全球氣候變遷造成更頻繁的極端天氣事件。

energy.example: Solar and wind power are clean renewable sources of energy.
energy.exampleZh: 太陽能與風力是潔淨的可再生能源。
energy.memoryTip: g 在 y 前發軟音 /dʒ/，en-er-gy

protect.example: National parks are established to protect wild animal habitats.
protect.exampleZh: 設立國家公園是為了保護野生動物的棲地。
protect.memoryTip: pro- (向前) + tect (覆蓋/遮蔽，如 detect)

disaster.example: The severe earthquake was the worst natural disaster in years.
disaster.exampleZh: 這場強烈地震是數年來最嚴重的自然災害。
disaster.memoryTip: dis- (不祥/負面) + aster (星象) ➔ 凶星降臨 ➔ 災難

typhoon.example: The powerful typhoon brought heavy rain and strong gusts.
typhoon.exampleZh: 這場強烈颱風帶來了豪雨與強勁陣風。
typhoon.memoryTip: 源自粵語「大風」音譯，ty (/taɪ/) + phoon (/fuːn/)

earthquake.example: Taiwan has strict building codes to withstand frequent earthquakes.
earthquake.exampleZh: 台灣制定了嚴格的建築防震法規以抵禦頻繁地震。

resource.example: Water is one of our most precious natural resources.
resource.exampleZh: 水是我們最寶貴的自然資源之一。

honest.example: It is always better to be honest than to tell lies.
honest.exampleZh: 誠實總比說謊來得更好。
honest.memoryTip: h 不發音！冠詞需使用 an honest person！

patient.example: Teachers must be patient when helping young learners.
patient.exampleZh: 老師在輔導年幼學習者時必須有耐心。

generous.example: He is generous enough to share his snacks with everyone.
generous.exampleZh: 他很大方，把自己的點心分給每個人享用。
generous.memoryTip: g 在 e 前發 /dʒ/，-ous 為形容詞字尾

confident.example: Practicing speaking will make you feel confident in exams.
confident.exampleZh: 多練習口說能讓你在考試時感到信心充足。

creative.example: The artist came up with a creative design for the poster.
creative.exampleZh: 該藝術家為海報想出了一個富有創意的設計。

responsible.example: Every team leader is responsible for organizing the tasks.
responsible.exampleZh: 每位隊長都負責組織統籌各項任務。

polite.example: Remember to be polite when asking someone for directions.
polite.exampleZh: 向別人問路時記得保持禮貌。
polite.memoryTip: Magic E 使 i 發長母音 /aɪ/

humorous.example: His humorous speech made the entire audience burst into laughter.
humorous.exampleZh: 他幽默的演說讓全場聽眾哈哈大笑。

energetic.zh: 充滿活力的、精力充沛的
energetic.example: The energetic puppies ran around the backyard all afternoon.
energetic.exampleZh: 充滿活力的小狗在後院玩耍了一整個下午。

respect.example: We should respect people from different cultural backgrounds.
respect.exampleZh: 我們應當尊重來自不同文化背景的人。
respect.memoryTip: re- (再/回頭) + spect (看) ➔ 回頭看 ➔ 敬重

decision.example: Think carefully before you make an important life decision.
decision.exampleZh: 在做人生重大決定前務必三思。

opinion.example: In my opinion, reading books expands your worldview greatly.
opinion.exampleZh: 依我看來，閱讀書籍能大幅開拓你的世界觀。

solution.example: Engineers worked around the clock to find a solution.
solution.exampleZh: 工程師們夜以繼日地尋找解決方法。

experience.example: Studying abroad was a valuable experience for the teenager.
experience.exampleZh: 出國留學對這名青少年而言是一段寶貴的經驗。
experience.memoryTip: ex- (外) + peri (嘗試/冒險) ➔ 經驗

opportunity.example: Do not miss the opportunity to study in such a fine program.
opportunity.exampleZh: 千萬不要錯過在這麼好的學程中學習的機會。
opportunity.memoryTip: op- (朝向) + port (港口) ➔ 船隻入港之良機

purpose.example: What was the main purpose of holding this emergency meeting?
purpose.exampleZh: 召開這次緊急會議的主要目的是什麼？

problem.example: Work as a team to solve this difficult math problem.
problem.exampleZh: 團隊合作來解決這道困難的數學難題。

reason.example: Can you give me a clear reason for your late arrival?
reason.exampleZh: 你能給我一個遲到的明確理由嗎？

result.example: As a result of diligent study, she received an A grade.
result.exampleZh: 由於勤奮讀書，她獲得了 A 等級的好成績。

memory.example: Going camping with family is one of my happiest memories.
memory.exampleZh: 和家人一起露營是我最快樂的童年回憶之一。

although.zh: 雖然、儘管 (引導讓步子句)
although.example: Although it was raining hard, the game continued as planned.
although.exampleZh: 雖然雨下得很大，比賽依然按計畫繼續進行。
although.memoryTip: 考點提醒：英文中 although 與 but 絕不可出現在同一個句子中！

however.example: The test was very difficult. However, Jane got a high score.
however.exampleZh: 考試非常困難。然而，珍依然拿到了高分。
however.memoryTip: 轉折副詞！不可直接連接兩子句，常置於句首加逗號。

therefore.example: He practiced diligently every day; therefore, he won the trophy.
therefore.exampleZh: 他每天勤奮練習；因此，他贏得了獎盃。
therefore.memoryTip: 表結果的副詞！不可與 because 連用。

unless.example: We will have a picnic tomorrow unless it rains heavily.
unless.exampleZh: 除非下大雨，否則我們明天會去野餐。
unless.memoryTip: unless 本身帶否定意味，其引導之子句不用 not！

especially.example: I enjoy outdoor sports, especially cycling along the river.
especially.exampleZh: 我喜歡戶外運動，特別是沿著河岸騎腳踏車。

immediately.example: When the fire alarm rang, everyone evacuated immediately.
immediately.exampleZh: 火警鈴響起時，每個人都立刻疏散撤離。
immediately.memoryTip: im- (不/無) + mediate (中間媒介) ➔ 不隔時間 ➔ 立刻

finally.example: After a twelve-hour flight, we finally arrived in London.
finally.exampleZh: 經過十二小時的飛行，我們終於抵達了倫敦。

suddenly.example: The car stopped suddenly when a dog ran across the street.
suddenly.exampleZh: 當一隻狗跑過馬路時，汽車突然煞停了下來。

almost.example: Dinner is almost ready, so please wash your hands.
almost.exampleZh: 晚餐幾乎快準備好了，請去洗手。
almost.memoryTip: al- (全) + most (大部分) ➔ 幾乎

nearly.example: We walked for nearly two hours before finding the station.
nearly.exampleZh: 我們走了將近兩小時才找到車站。

begin.example: The concert will begin promptly at seven thirty.
begin.exampleZh: 音樂會將於七點半準時開始。

become.example: He worked hard and eventually became a respected doctor.
become.exampleZh: 他努力奮鬥，最終成為一位受人尊敬的醫生。

blow.example: Strong wind blew away all the dry leaves on the ground.
blow.exampleZh: 強風吹走了地上所有的乾樹葉。

draw.example: The talented artist drew a magnificent portrait.
draw.exampleZh: 那位才華洋溢的藝術家畫了一幅壯麗的肖像。

drink.example: Athletes drank plenty of water after the marathon.
drink.exampleZh: 運動員在馬拉松跑完後喝了大量的水。

eat.example: We ate delicious homemade noodles at grandma's house.
eat.exampleZh: 我們在奶奶家吃了美味的手工麵條。

fly.example: Birds fly south to seek warmer weather in winter.
fly.exampleZh: 鳥兒在冬天向南飛尋求更溫暖的氣候。

get.example: She studied thoroughly to get top marks on the final test.
get.exampleZh: 她徹底複習以在期末考拿到頂尖成績。

ring.example: The school bell rang, signaling the end of the school day.
ring.exampleZh: 學校鐘聲響起，宣告放學時間已到。

run.example: He ran as fast as he could to deliver the message.
run.exampleZh: 他以最快速度奔跑去傳遞消息。

say.example: The teacher said that practice makes perfect.
say.memoryTip: 三態：say /seɪ/ ➔ said /sɛd/ ➔ said /sɛd/！注意音標短母音

education.example: Education plays a critical role in shaping a child's future.
education.exampleZh: 教育在塑造孩子的未來中扮演關鍵角色。

grammar.example: Understanding basic grammar rules makes writing much easier.
grammar.exampleZh: 理解基礎文法規則讓寫作變得容易許多。
grammar.memoryTip: 雙寫 m，gram /ɡræm/ + mar /ɚ/，注意結尾是 ar！

vocabulary.example: Reading articles regularly helps students expand their vocabulary.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 定期閱讀文章能幫助學生擴充單字量。

pronunciation.example: Listen to native audio recordings to improve your pronunciation.
pronunciation.exampleZh: 收聽母語者錄音以改善你的發音。
pronunciation.memoryTip: 注意拼寫：pronounce ➔ pronunciation (沒有 o)！

dictionary.example: If you encounter an unfamiliar word, look it up in a dictionary.
dictionary.exampleZh: 如果遇到不認識的字，請查字典。

comprehension.example: The test includes questions measuring reading comprehension.
comprehension.exampleZh: 該測驗包含評量閱讀理解能力的題目。

describe.example: Can you describe what the suspect looked like?
describe.exampleZh: 你能描述一下嫌疑犯長什麼樣子嗎？
describe.memoryTip: de- (向下) + scribe (書寫) ➔ 描繪

improve.example: Continuous practice will help you improve your speaking skills.
improve.exampleZh: 持續練習將幫助你增進口語技巧。

government.example: The government announced new environmental conservation policies.
government.exampleZh: 政府宣布了新的環境保育政策。

community.example: Volunteers collected food to help the elderly in their community.
community.exampleZh: 志工們收集食物來幫助社區裡的長者。

volunteer.example: Many high school students work as volunteers at the shelter.
volunteer.exampleZh: 許多高中生在收容所擔任志工服務。

citizen.example: A responsible citizen obeys the laws and protects public property.
citizen.exampleZh: 負責任的公民遵守法律並愛護公物。

profession.example: Nursing is a demanding yet deeply rewarding profession.
profession.exampleZh: 護理是一項要求嚴格卻深具回報的崇高專業。

journey.example: They wished him a safe and wonderful journey across Europe.
journey.exampleZh: 他們祝他橫越歐洲的旅程平安且精彩。
journey.memoryTip: jour (日) ➔ 一日的行程 ➔ 旅程

passport.example: You must show a valid passport when boarding an international flight.
passport.exampleZh: 登上班機時你必須出示有效護照。
passport.memoryTip: pass (通過) + port (港口/口岸) ➔ 護照

passenger.example: All passengers must fasten their seatbelts before takeoff.
passenger.exampleZh: 起飛前所有乘客必須繫好安全帶。

schedule.example: The train arrived right on schedule despite the heavy rain.
schedule.exampleZh: 儘管下著大雨，火車依然準時抵達。

culture.example: Traveling to new countries allows you to experience different cultures.
culture.exampleZh: 去新國家旅行讓你能體驗不同的文化。

medicine.example: Take this prescribed medicine three times a day after meals.
medicine.exampleZh: 請於三餐飯後服用這款處方藥物。

hospital.example: The injured driver was rushed to the nearby hospital.
hospital.exampleZh: 受傷的駕駛被迅速送往附近醫院急救。

disease.example: Regular handwashing helps prevent the spread of infectious disease.
disease.exampleZh: 常洗手有助於預防傳染病的傳播。
disease.memoryTip: dis- (不/非) + ease (安適) ➔ 身體不安 ➔ 疾病

symptom.example: Fever, cough, and sore throat are common symptoms of the flu.
symptom.exampleZh: 發燒、咳嗽和喉嚨痛是流感的常見症狀。

exercise.example: Doing aerobic exercise thirty minutes a day strengthens your heart.
exercise.exampleZh: 每天做三十分鐘有氧運動能強化你的心臟。

cost.zh: 花費（金錢）；成本 (三態 cost-cost-cost)
cost.example: The new smartphone cost three hundred dollars.
cost.exampleZh: 這款新智慧型手機花費了三百美元。
cost.memoryTip: 事物當主詞！物 + cost + 人 + 金錢。三態同形！

cut.example: Use safety scissors to cut the colored paper carefully.
cut.exampleZh: 請使用安全剪刀仔細剪裁色紙。

hit.example: The batter hit the baseball over the fence.
hit.exampleZh: 擊球手將棒球打出了全壘打牆外。

hurt.zh: 傷害、使疼痛；受傷的 (三態 hurt-hurt-hurt)
hurt.example: He hurt his ankle while playing soccer yesterday.
hurt.exampleZh: 他昨天踢足球時傷到了腳踝。

let.zh: 讓、允許 (使役動詞，三態 let-let-let)
let.example: Please let me know if you need any assistance.
let.exampleZh: 如果你需要任何協助請讓我知道。
let.memoryTip: 使役動詞！後接受詞 + 原形動詞。三態同形！

put.example: Put on your heavy coat before going outdoors.
put.exampleZh: 出門前穿上你的厚大衣。

quit.example: Dad decided to quit smoking for the sake of his health.
quit.exampleZh: 為了身體健康爸爸決定戒菸。
quit.memoryTip: quit 後接 V-ing。三態同形！

shut.example: Please shut the window because the wind is getting cold.
shut.exampleZh: 請關上窗戶，因為風越來越涼了。

bite.example: Be careful; that stray dog might bite if frightened.
bite.exampleZh: 請小心，那隻流浪狗如果受驚可能會咬人。

forgive.example: True friends readily forgive each other's mistakes.
forgive.exampleZh: 真正的朋友總會寬恕彼此的過失。

understand.example: Do you understand what the teacher just explained?
understand.exampleZh: 你理解老師剛才說明的內容了嗎？

knowledge.example: Reading widely is the best way to gain useful knowledge.
knowledge.exampleZh: 博覽群書是獲取實用知識的最佳途徑。
knowledge.memoryTip: k 不發音！knowl /nɑː/ + edge /lɪdʒ/，注意不可數！

attitude.example: A positive learning attitude leads to remarkable progress.
attitude.exampleZh: 積極的學習態度能帶來顯著的進步。

habit.example: Reading for thirty minutes every day is an excellent habit.
habit.exampleZh: 每天閱讀三十分鐘是一項極佳的習慣。

concept.example: Make sure you master the core concepts before the exam.
concept.exampleZh: 考試前務必精熟核心觀念。
concept.memoryTip: con- + cept (抓取) ➔ 抓取本質 ➔ 概念

reality.example: We must face reality and find practical ways to solve this.
reality.exampleZh: 我們必須面對現實並尋求切實的解決之道。

wisdom.example: Elders often pass down valuable words of wisdom.
wisdom.exampleZh: 長者常傳承下寶貴的智慧箴言。

scientist.example: Scientists are researching clean renewable energy sources.
scientist.exampleZh: 科學家們正在研究潔淨的可再生能源。

engineer.example: The software engineer designed a powerful mobile app.
engineer.exampleZh: 軟體工程師設計了一款強大的行動應用程式。

doctor.example: You should see a doctor if your high fever persists.
doctor.exampleZh: 如果你的高燒持續不退，你應該去看醫生。

nurse.example: The caring nurse took gentle care of the young patient.
nurse.exampleZh: 貼心的護理師溫柔地照料這位年幼的病患。

officer.example: The police officer directed traffic at the busy crossroads.
officer.exampleZh: 警官在繁忙的十字路口指揮交通。

musician.example: The classical musician played the violin beautifully.
musician.exampleZh: 那位古典音樂家優美地演奏了小提琴。

borrow.example: Can I borrow your English dictionary for today's lesson?
borrow.exampleZh: 今天的課我可以向你借用英文字典嗎？
borrow.memoryTip: 向外借入！borrow + 物 + from + 人

lend.example: He kindly lent his spare umbrella to his classmate.
lend.exampleZh: 他親切地將備用雨傘借給了他的同學。
lend.memoryTip: 借出給人！lend + 物 + to + 人。三態：lend ➔ lent ➔ lent

affect.example: Lack of sleep can seriously affect your academic performance.
affect.exampleZh: 睡眠不足會嚴重影響你的學業表現。
affect.memoryTip: 動詞！以 a 起首。常考：Smoking affects health.

effect.example: Regular exercise has a positive effect on your immune system.
effect.exampleZh: 規律運動對你的免疫系統有正面的良好效果。
effect.memoryTip: 名詞！以 e 起首。常考片語：have an effect on...

accept.example: She gladly accepted the invitation to the birthday party.
accept.exampleZh: 她欣然接受了參加生日派對的邀請。
accept.memoryTip: ac- (朝向) + cept (收下) ➔ 接受

except.example: Everyone passed the examination except John.
except.exampleZh: 除了約翰之外，每個人都通過了考試。
except.memoryTip: ex- (排除在外) ➔ 不包含在內！

beside.example: Come and sit beside me so we can read together.
beside.exampleZh: 過來坐在我身旁，這樣我們可以一起閱讀。

besides.example: Besides English, she also speaks fluent Japanese and Spanish.
besides.exampleZh: 除了英文之外，她還能說流利的日文與西班牙文。
besides.memoryTip: 字尾多個 s ➔ 表「加上、還有」！

distinguish.category: 大考核心動詞 / Critical Thinking
distinguish.collocation: distinguish between A and B (區分 A 與 B)
distinguish.example: Critical readers can readily distinguish between objective facts and personal opinions.
distinguish.exampleZh: 具備批判思維的讀者能夠輕易區分客觀事實與個人主觀意見。
distinguish.memoryTip: dis- (分開) + tinct/tinguish (刺/做記號) ➔ 刺上不同記號以分開 ➔ 區分辨別

sustainable.category: 永續發展與跨領域 / Sustainability
sustainable.example: Solar and wind energy are crucial components of a sustainable green economy.
sustainable.exampleZh: 太陽能與風能是永續綠色經濟至關重要的基石。
sustainable.memoryTip: sus- (在下方) + tain (握住/支撐) + -able ➔ 能在底層長久支撐的 ➔ 永續的

phenomenon.category: 大考學術閱讀詞彙 / Academic
phenomenon.zh: 現象、非凡奇蹟 (複數 phenomena)
phenomenon.example: The northern lights are a breathtaking natural phenomenon visible in polar regions.
phenomenon.exampleZh: 極光是北極地區令人嘆為觀止的自然現象。
phenomenon.memoryTip: 希臘字根 phain- (顯現/光芒)。注意複數為 phenomena！

innovative.collocation: innovative approach / design (創新的途徑/設計)
innovative.example: The biotech startup proposed an innovative method for rapid vaccine synthesis.
innovative.exampleZh: 該生技新創提出了一種快速合成疫苗的創新方法。
innovative.memoryTip: in- (進入) + nov (新，如 novel) + -ative ➔ 注入嶄新思維 ➔ 創新的

conservation.category: 永續發展與跨領域 / Environment
conservation.example: Marine conservation programs protect vulnerable coral reefs from ocean warming.
conservation.exampleZh: 海洋保育計畫保護脆弱的珊瑚礁免於海洋暖化的威脅。
conservation.memoryTip: con- (共同) + serv (保護/保持，如 preserve) + -ation ➔ 共同守護 ➔ 保育

diversity.collocation: biological / cultural diversity (生物/文化多樣性)
diversity.example: Tropical rainforests boast the richest biological diversity on our planet.
diversity.exampleZh: 熱帶雨林擁有地球上最豐富的生物多樣性。
diversity.memoryTip: di- (分開) + vers/vert (轉向，如 convert) + -ity ➔ 轉向不同方向 ➔ 多樣性

resilience.example: Children who overcome early adversity often develop remarkable emotional resilience.
resilience.exampleZh: 克服早期逆境的孩子往往能培養出非凡的情感韌性。
resilience.memoryTip: re- (回) + sili (跳，如 salient) + -ence ➔ 被打擊後能回跳彈起 ➔ 復原力/韌性

comprehensive.category: 大考學術閱讀詞彙 / Academic
comprehensive.zh: 全面的、綜合性的、廣泛的
comprehensive.collocation: comprehensive review / survey (全面性的審查/調查)
comprehensive.example: The medical textbook provides a comprehensive overview of human anatomy.
comprehensive.exampleZh: 該醫學教科書提供了人體解剖學的全面性綜述。
comprehensive.memoryTip: com- (完全) + prehens (抓住，如 comprehend) + -ive ➔ 全面囊括抓住 ➔ 廣泛全面的

contribute.collocation: contribute to + V-ing/N (促成某事/導致某結果)
contribute.example: Excessive intake of processed sugar significantly contributes to obesity and heart disease.
contribute.exampleZh: 過量攝取精緻糖是導致肥胖與心臟疾病的重大因素。
contribute.memoryTip: con- (共同) + tribute (給予/貢獻，如 tribute) ➔ 一起給予 ➔ 貢獻/促成

perspective.collocation: from a global perspective (從全球視角來看)
perspective.example: Studying abroad allows students to examine domestic issues from an objective perspective.
perspective.exampleZh: 出國留學能讓學生從客觀的視角來審視國內議題。
perspective.memoryTip: per- (穿透) + spect (看，如 inspect) + -ive ➔ 穿透看清全局 ➔ 視角觀點

consequence.category: 大考學術閱讀詞彙 / Causality
consequence.zh: 後果、結果 (常指負面影響)
consequence.example: Rising sea levels are a direct consequence of relentless global greenhouse emissions.
consequence.exampleZh: 海平面上升是持續不斷的全球溫室氣體排放所導致的直接後果。
consequence.memoryTip: con- (跟隨) + sequ (跟隨，如 sequence) + -ence ➔ 跟在後面發生的事 ➔ 後果

fundamental.category: 大考學術閱讀詞彙 / Academic

specifications.zh: 產品規格、技術明細 (常複數)

specifications.memoryTip: specific (明確具體的) ➔ 規格明細書

agenda.collocation: items on the agenda (議程上的討論事項)

agenda.memoryTip: ag- (做/行動，如 agent) ➔ 要付諸行動的事項清單 ➔ 議程

revenue.zh: 營收、收入 (指公司營業額)
revenue.collocation: annual revenue growth (年度營收增長)
revenue.example: Quarterly earnings reports showed a twelve percent surge in overseas subscription revenue.
revenue.exampleZh: 季度財報顯示海外訂閱營收大幅攀升了百分之十二。
revenue.memoryTip: re- (回) + ven (來，如 venue) ➔ 資金回流 ➔ 營收

warranty.category: 商務合約與談判 / Customer Service
warranty.example: All purchased electronic appliances come with a two-year limited manufacturer warranty.
warranty.exampleZh: 所有購買的電子家電均附有製造商提供的兩年有限保固。

delegate.zh: 會議代表；委派、授權 (工作責任)
delegate.collocation: delegate tasks to subordinates (委派任務給下屬)
delegate.example: Effective executives learn how to delegate operational responsibilities to experienced team leaders.
delegate.exampleZh: 高效的企業主管懂得如何將日常營運職責授權委派給資深的團隊組長。
delegate.memoryTip: 名詞發短母音 /-ɡət/ 代表；動詞發長母音 /-ɡeɪt/ 授權委派

logistics.category: 物流與製造管理 / Supply Chain
logistics.collocation: global supply chain and logistics (全球供應鏈與物流)
logistics.example: The e-commerce conglomerate upgraded its regional logistics centers to ensure next-day delivery.

inventory.example: The retail warehouse closes for half a day each quarter to conduct a complete physical inventory.
inventory.exampleZh: 該零售倉庫每季暫停營業半天以進行全面性的實體庫存盤點。
inventory.memoryTip: in- (入) + vent (來到) ➔ 盤點進貨來到倉庫的所有商品 ➔ 庫存

confidential.collocation: strictly confidential information (高度機密資訊)
confidential.example: All patent blueprints and financial records must be stored in strictly confidential digital vaults.
confidential.exampleZh: 所有專利藍圖與財務紀錄都必須儲存在高度機密的數位保險庫中。
confidential.memoryTip: con- (加強) + fid (信任，同 confidence) + -tial ➔ 僅能告知受信任之人的 ➔ 機密的

compliance.zh: 法規遵從、合規性 (搭配 with)
compliance.collocation: in compliance with safety regulations (符合安全法規)
compliance.example: The pharmaceutical manufacturing facility operates in strict compliance with federal FDA standards.
compliance.exampleZh: 該製藥生產廠房的營運嚴格遵從聯邦 FDA 的規範標準。
compliance.memoryTip: comply with (遵守) ➔ 名詞 compliance

merger.example: The proposed merger between the two airline corporations awaits antitrust regulatory approval.
merger.exampleZh: 兩家航空公司擬議中的合併案正在等待反托拉斯監管機構的審查批准。
merger.memoryTip: merge (融入/結合) + -er ➔ 結合成為一家公司 ➔ 合併

invoice.zh: 發票、出貨請款單；開立發票
invoice.collocation: issue an invoice (開立請款發票)
invoice.example: Payment will be remitted within thirty days upon receipt of the official contractor invoice.
invoice.exampleZh: 收到承包商的正式請款發票後，款項將在三十天內匯出。
invoice.memoryTip: envoi (法語：寄出送出) ➔ 隨貨物寄出的付款明細清單 ➔ 請款單

compensation.collocation: compensation package (整體薪酬福利方案)
compensation.example: The enterprise offers a highly competitive compensation package including comprehensive health insurance.
compensation.exampleZh: 該企業提供極具競爭力的薪資福利方案，包含全額健保與績效獎金。
compensation.memoryTip: compensate (補償/酬謝) ➔ 勞動付出的報酬 ➔ 薪酬

turnover.zh: 員工離職流動率；商品營業額
turnover.collocation: high employee turnover rate (偏高的員工流動率)
turnover.example: Implementing flexible telecommuting policies successfully reduced staff turnover by twenty percent.
turnover.exampleZh: 實施彈性遠端辦公政策成功使員工離職流動率降低了百分之二十。
turnover.memoryTip: turn (轉) + over (翻過去) ➔ 人員頻繁更替流動

feasibility.collocation: conduct a feasibility study (執行可行性研究)
feasibility.example: The urban planning board commissioned a comprehensive feasibility study for the light rail transit.
feasibility.exampleZh: 都市計畫委員會委託針對輕軌捷運系統進行了全面的可行性研究。
feasibility.memoryTip: feasible (可行的，同 able to do) + -ity ➔ 可行性

appraisal.zh: 員工績效考核；資產估價

appraisal.exampleZh: 升遷與加薪幅度是在正式的年終績效考核期間決定的。
appraisal.memoryTip: praise (稱讚/評鑑價值) ➔ 評估價值與表現 ➔ 考核估價

deficit.zh: 財政赤字、虧損額 (反義詞 surplus)
deficit.example: The finance director warned that unexpected supply chain disruptions could widen the quarterly deficit.
deficit.exampleZh: 財務長警告，非預期的供應鏈中斷可能會擴大本季度的財政赤字。
deficit.memoryTip: de- (欠缺) + fic (做) ➔ 入不敷出 ➔ 赤字

surplus.zh: 盈餘、過剩；剩餘的 (反義詞 deficit)
surplus.example: A strong export performance in semiconductors yielded a record trade surplus this quarter.
surplus.exampleZh: 半導體強勁的出口表現為本季度帶來了創紀錄的貿易順差盈餘。
surplus.memoryTip: sur- (超過) + plus (加上) ➔ 超過所需留下來的 ➔ 盈餘

vendor.collocation: approved vendor list (合格供應商名錄)
vendor.example: The corporate procurement team only contracts with vendors who guarantee green manufacturing practices.
vendor.exampleZh: 企業採購團隊僅與保證符合綠色製造規範的供應商簽訂合約。
vendor.memoryTip: vend (販賣，如 vending machine 自動販賣機) + -or (人/機構) ➔ 供應商

contingency.zh: 緊急應變方案、意外事故預備
contingency.example: The risk management committee formulated a contingency plan in case of power grid failures.
contingency.exampleZh: 風險管理委員會擬定了一份緊急應變備案，以防電網發生故障。
contingency.memoryTip: con- (共同) + ting/tang (接觸/發生) ➔ 萬一意外降臨時的應對方案 ➔ 備案

terminate.collocation: terminate a contractual agreement (解除合約協議)
terminate.example: Either party reserves the legal right to terminate the contract upon thirty days written notice.
terminate.exampleZh: 任何一方均保留在提前三十天提出書面通知後終止合約的法定權利。
terminate.memoryTip: term (界限/終點，如 terminal 航廈/終點站) + -ate ➔ 到達終點 ➔ 終止合約

lucrative.collocation: lucrative contract / market (獲利豐厚的合約/利潤可觀的市場)
lucrative.example: Securing the government cloud infrastructure tender proved to be a highly lucrative venture.
lucrative.exampleZh: 贏得政府雲端基礎建設的標案被證實是一項獲利極為豐厚的商業投資。
lucrative.memoryTip: lucre (錢財利潤) + -ative ➔ 利潤滾滾的 ➔ 獲利豐厚的

unanimous.zh: 全體一致的、毫無異議的

unanimous.exampleZh: 董事會全體一致通過了新任營運長的人事任命案。
unanimous.memoryTip: un- (單一，如 unite) + anim (心智，如 animal) + -ous ➔ 眾人一條心 ➔ 全體一致的

affiliate.zh: 附屬機構、分公司；使隸屬

affiliate.exampleZh: 該媒體巨頭透過其海外歐洲分公司與關係機構發行串流影音內容。
affiliate.memoryTip: af- (朝向) + fili (兒子，如 filial 孝順的) + -ate ➔ 收為子機構 ➔ 附屬機構/分會

dividend.zh: 股利、紅利 (上市公司配發予股東)

dividend.memoryTip: divide (分開) + -end ➔ 分發利潤給股東 ➔ 股利紅利

consortium.zh: 企業聯盟、跨國財團、合夥聯合體
consortium.collocation: international banking consortium (國際銀行聯合團)
consortium.example: A consortium of engineering firms submitted a joint bid to construct the high-speed rail line.
consortium.exampleZh: 由多家工程公司組成的聯合財團提交了建造高鐵路線的共同投標書。
consortium.memoryTip: con- (共同) + sort (命運/同類) + -ium ➔ 命運相連的聯合組織 ➔ 財團/聯合體

deadline.collocation: meet / miss the strict deadline (趕上/錯過嚴格的截止期限)
deadline.example: The engineering team worked overtime to ensure the software release met the launch deadline.
deadline.exampleZh: 工程團隊全力加班以確保軟體發表能如期趕上發布截止日。
deadline.memoryTip: dead (死) + line (線) ➔ 超過這條線就出局 ➔ 截止死線

audit.collocation: annual financial audit (年度財務審計)

liability.zh: 法律責任、賠償責任；債務負債

incentive.zh: 激勵措施、獎勵誘因、獎金

negotiable.memoryTip: negotiate (談判) + -able ➔ 可以再談的 ➔ 可協商的

leverage.zh: 善加利用 (資源/優勢)；槓桿操作
leverage.collocation: leverage market leadership (善加發揮市場領先優勢)

leverage.exampleZh: 該品牌計畫善用社群媒體意見領袖的影響力，以觸及年輕消費客群。

bankruptcy.collocation: file for bankruptcy protection (申請破產保護)

bankruptcy.memoryTip: bank (銀行長凳) + rupt (斷裂破碎，同 interrupt) ➔ 錢莊櫃台被砸碎 ➔ 破產

entrepreneur.collocation: aspiring tech entrepreneur (有抱負的科技創業者)

endorsement.zh: 名人代言；背書、公開支持

headquarters.memoryTip: head (首腦) + quarters (駐地營區) ➔ 司令總部/總公司

recession.collocation: deep economic recession (嚴重的經濟衰退蕭條)

recession.memoryTip: re- (向後) + cess (行走，同 process) + -ion ➔ 經濟往後倒退 ➔ 衰退

corroborate.zh: 證實、確證、提供客觀證據支持
corroborate.collocation: corroborate the scientific hypothesis (證實該科學假說)

corroborate.memoryTip: cor- (加強) + robor (強壯/穩固，同 robust) + -ate ➔ 使論據更穩固 ➔ 證實

anomalous.zh: 異常的、不規則的、反常規的
anomalous.collocation: anomalous experimental readings (反常的實驗讀數)

anomalous.memoryTip: a- (否定/無) + nomos (規則/常規) + -ous ➔ 不合乎常規的 ➔ 異常的

substantiate.category: 論據與實證支持 / Textual Evidence

substantiate.collocation: substantiate claims with empirical data (以經驗數據佐證主張)

substantiate.memoryTip: substance (實質實體) ➔ 為論點提供實質骨肉 ➔ 證實 (= corroborate)

pragmatic.zh: 務實的、注重實效的 (反義詞 idealistic / dogmatic)
pragmatic.collocation: a pragmatic policy solution (務實的政策解決方案)

ambivalent.zh: 心存矛盾的、悲喜交集的、猶豫不決的

disparage.collocation: disparage rivals' achievements (貶低競爭對手的成就)

disparage.exampleZh: 學者應建設性地探討理論觀點，而非惡意貶低對立方的學術主張。
disparage.memoryTip: dis- (否定) + par (同等，同 peer/pair) ➔ 視為不如自己平起平坐 ➔ 貶損輕視

underscore.zh: 強調、突顯、在底下劃線 (= emphasize)
underscore.collocation: underscore the urgent need for reform (突顯改革的迫切需求)
underscore.example: The recent seismic event underscores the necessity of reinforcing municipal bridge structures.
underscore.exampleZh: 最近發生的地震事件突顯了加固市區橋樑結構的迫切必要性。
underscore.memoryTip: under (在...底下) + score (劃線記號) ➔ 在重點底下劃重點線 ➔ 強調突顯

unprecedented.collocation: unprecedented technological growth (空前的科技爆發成長)
unprecedented.example: The rapid rollout of the global vaccination campaign occurred at an unprecedented speed.
unprecedented.exampleZh: 全球疫苗接種行動的迅速鋪開，是以史上空前未有的速度進行的。
unprecedented.memoryTip: un- (無) + precedent (先例) + -ed ➔ 沒有前例可循的 ➔ 史無前例的

contentious.zh: 有爭議的、引發激烈爭論的
contentious.collocation: a contentious constitutional issue (具重大爭議的憲法議題)
contentious.example: Allocating municipal tax revenues to private sports stadiums proved to be a highly contentious issue.
contentious.exampleZh: 將市政稅收提撥補助私人體育場館，被證實是一個極具爭議的議題。
contentious.memoryTip: contend (爭奪/奮戰) + -ious ➔ 容易引發爭奪爭論的 ➔ 有爭議的

empirical.zh: 以經驗/實驗為依據的、實證的
empirical.collocation: empirical evidence / research (實證證據/經驗研究)
empirical.example: Theoretical quantum models require empirical validation through particle accelerator collisions.
empirical.exampleZh: 量子力學的理論模型必須透過粒子加速器碰撞實驗的實證檢驗。
empirical.memoryTip: em- (在內) + pir (嘗試/試驗，同 experiment) ➔ 靠實際試驗得來的 ➔ 實證的

esoteric.zh: 深奧難懂的、秘傳的 (僅少數圈內人知曉)
esoteric.collocation: esoteric philosophical doctrines (深奧玄妙的哲學學說)
esoteric.example: Medieval alchemy texts were intentionally written in esoteric symbols to conceal chemical formulas.
esoteric.exampleZh: 中世紀煉金術文獻刻意使用深奧難懂的符號撰寫，以隱匿化學配方。
esoteric.memoryTip: eso- (內在的/圈內的) + -teric ➔ 只有小圈子密友懂得 ➔ 深奧秘傳的

aesthetic.zh: 美學的、審美的；審美標準
aesthetic.collocation: aesthetic appeal / sensibilities (美學吸引力/審美品味)
aesthetic.example: Modern architecture often prioritizes functional simplicity over ornate aesthetic decoration.
aesthetic.exampleZh: 現代建築設計往往將功能性簡潔置於華麗的美學裝飾之上。
aesthetic.memoryTip: 希臘字根 aisthet- (知覺/感知) ➔ 感知美的事物 ➔ 美學審美的

ubiquitous.zh: 無所不在的、普及的 (= omnipresent)
ubiquitous.collocation: ubiquitous mobile connectivity (無所不在的行動連線)
ubiquitous.example: Touchscreen payment terminals have become ubiquitous in metropolitan cafes and retail shops.
ubiquitous.exampleZh: 觸控式感應支付終端機在大都市的咖啡館與零售門市已變得無所不在。
ubiquitous.memoryTip: ubi (在哪裡，同 where) + -quitous ➔ 走到哪裡都有 ➔ 無所不在的

bolster.zh: 支撐、加固、支持 (論點或信心)
bolster.collocation: bolster the central thesis (支持/鞏固核心論點)
bolster.example: The sociologist cited longitudinal demographic statistics to bolster her conclusions.
bolster.exampleZh: 該社會學家引用了長期的縱貫人口統計數據來鞏固加強她的結論。
bolster.memoryTip: 原意為厚長的墊枕 (bolster) ➔ 在背後墊高支撐 ➔ 支持加強

plausible.zh: 貌似合理的、合乎情理的
plausible.collocation: a plausible explanation (看似合理的解釋)
plausible.example: Paleontologists offered a plausible explanation for the sudden extinction of the apex predators.
plausible.exampleZh: 古生物學家對頂級掠食者的驟然滅絕提出了貌似合理的解釋。
plausible.memoryTip: plaus/plaud (拍手喝采，同 applaud) + -ible ➔ 令人拍手贊同的 ➔ 貌似合理的

scrutinize.category: 論據與實證支持 / Critical Analysis
scrutinize.zh: 仔細審視、嚴密檢驗、端詳
scrutinize.collocation: scrutinize the financial audit (嚴格審查財務審計報告)
scrutinize.example: Regulatory watchdogs rigorously scrutinize the drug trials before approving retail sales.
scrutinize.exampleZh: 監管機構在批准藥品上市銷售前，會嚴格審視其臨床試驗數據。
scrutinize.memoryTip: scruta (碎片/破爛) ➔ 翻找每個碎片仔細檢查 ➔ 嚴格審視

lucid.zh: 清晰易懂的、頭腦清醒明晰的
lucid.collocation: lucid explanation / prose (清晰明白的解釋/散文)
lucid.example: Despite the intricacy of neurochemistry, the lecturer offered a remarkably lucid explanation.
lucid.exampleZh: 儘管神經化學錯綜複雜，該講師依然給出了極其清晰明白的解說。
lucid.memoryTip: luc (光亮，同 translucent) ➔ 透著光亮的 ➔ 清晰透徹的

elucidate.collocation: elucidate the complex theory (闡明複雜理論)
elucidate.example: The diagrams were specifically designed to elucidate the intricate mechanisms of DNA replication.
elucidate.exampleZh: 這些圖解專門設計用以闡明 DNA 複製複製過程中的繁複機制。
elucidate.memoryTip: e- (出) + luc (光) + -idate ➔ 將光照耀出來 ➔ 闡明解釋

superfluous.collocation: superfluous details / spending (多餘多贅的細節/過剩支出)
superfluous.example: The editor eliminated several superfluous paragraphs to improve the rhythm and pacing of the novel.
superfluous.exampleZh: 編輯刪除了若干多餘累贅的段落，以提升小說的節奏與明快度。
superfluous.memoryTip: super- (超過) + flu (流動) + -ous ➔ 水滿溢位來 ➔ 多餘過剩的

paradoxical.zh: 自相矛盾的、似非而是的
paradoxical.collocation: a paradoxical outcome (自相矛盾的結果)
paradoxical.example: It is paradoxical that increased automation has sometimes resulted in longer working hours.
paradoxical.exampleZh: 自動化程度提高有時反而導致工時變長，這是一項看似矛盾的現象。
paradoxical.memoryTip: para- (超越/相悖) + dox (觀點信條，同 orthodox) ➔ 與常理觀點相悖 ➔ 矛盾似有理的

tentative.zh: 試驗性的、暫定未決的、猶豫的
tentative.collocation: tentative agreement / conclusion (暫定協議/初步試驗結論)
tentative.example: The researchers reached a tentative conclusion pending further genomic sequencing confirmation.
tentative.exampleZh: 研究人員得出一項初步暫定結論，正等待進一步基因組定序的證實。
tentative.memoryTip: tent- (摸索/嘗試，同 attempt) + -ative ➔ 摸石過河嘗試中的 ➔ 暫定的

coherent.zh: 條理連貫的、前後一致的
coherent.collocation: a coherent narrative / argument (條理清晰的敘事/論述)
coherent.example: The essay lacks a coherent structure, jumping erratically between unrelated historical epochs.
coherent.exampleZh: 該散文缺乏連貫條理的結構，在不相關的歷史時代之間跳躍不定。
coherent.memoryTip: co- (共同) + her/hes (黏著，同 adhesive) ➔ 緊密黏合不散漫 ➔ 條理連貫的

discredit.zh: 使喪失信譽、懷疑其真實性
discredit.collocation: discredit the false rumor (破除不實謠言使其不可信)
discredit.example: Rigorous investigative journalism completely discredited the company's misleading environmental claims.
discredit.exampleZh: 嚴謹的調查報導徹底推翻了該公司具誤導性的環保宣言，使其名譽掃地。
discredit.memoryTip: dis- (去除) + credit (信用) ➔ 剝奪其信用 ➔ 使不可信

augment.collocation: augment memory / capacity (擴充記憶體/增強產能)
augment.example: Surgeons use augmented reality headsets to guide delicate microsurgical incisions.
augment.exampleZh: 外科醫師使用擴增實境頭戴裝置來引導精細的顯微手術切口。
augment.memoryTip: aug- (增加，同 auction 拍賣/august 尊貴) ➔ 擴充強化

polarize.zh: 使兩極分化、使截然對立
polarize.collocation: polarize public sentiment (使公眾輿論走向兩極對立)
polarize.example: Economic inequality and sensationalized media tend to polarize national political discourse.
polarize.exampleZh: 經濟不平等與煽情化媒體往往導致國家政治論述走向極端兩極化。
polarize.memoryTip: polar (極地的/兩極的) + -ize ➔ 走向南北極端 ➔ 使兩極分化

synthesize.zh: 綜合、合成、統整各方觀點
synthesize.collocation: synthesize diverse perspectives (統整多元視角觀點)
synthesize.example: The concluding chapter synthesizes findings from forty separate international field trials.
synthesize.exampleZh: 結論章節綜合統整了來自四十項獨立國際田野試驗的研究成果。
synthesize.memoryTip: syn- (共同) + the (放置) + -ize ➔ 放到一起融會貫通 ➔ 綜合合成

equivocal.zh: 模稜兩可的、含糊其辭的
equivocal.collocation: an equivocal answer (模稜兩可含糊的回答)
equivocal.example: His equivocal response left both journalists unsure whether he intended to run for office.
equivocal.exampleZh: 他含糊其辭的回答讓在場記者皆無法確定他是否打算競選公職。
equivocal.memoryTip: equi (平等) + voc (聲音) ➔ 兩種聲音平分秋色說不清楚 ➔ 模稜兩可的

preclude.zh: 預先排除、防堵、使不可能發生
preclude.collocation: preclude the possibility of error (杜絕發生錯誤的可能性)
preclude.example: A severe wrist injury precluded the tennis prodigy from competing in the national tournament.
preclude.exampleZh: 嚴重的手腕傷勢使這位網球神童無法參加全國錦標賽。
preclude.memoryTip: pre- (預先) + clud (關閉，同 exclude) ➔ 預先關上大門 ➔ 排除阻止

candid.zh: 坦率直言的、公正誠實的
candid.collocation: candid interview / remarks (坦誠的專訪/直率言論)
candid.example: In a candid retrospective, the retired diplomat recounted the missteps of foreign policy.
candid.exampleZh: 在一篇坦誠直言的回憶錄中，這位退役外交官回顧了外交政策的種種失誤。
candid.memoryTip: cand (白色/純潔，同 candidate 穿白袍的候選人) ➔ 赤誠坦白 ➔ 坦率的

exacerbate.zh: 使惡化、加劇、雪上加霜 (反義詞 ameliorate / mitigate)
exacerbate.collocation: exacerbate existing shortages (加劇既有物資短缺危機)
exacerbate.example: Prolonged agricultural drought exacerbated food scarcity across the developing nation.
exacerbate.exampleZh: 長期的農業乾旱加劇了整個開發中國家的糧食短缺危機。
exacerbate.memoryTip: ex- (加強) + acerb (酸苦辛辣，同 acerbic) + -ate ➔ 使酸苦惡化 ➔ 加劇惡化

capricious.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Volatility
capricious.zh: 反覆無常的、善變任性的
capricious.example: Throughout his turbulent tenure, the autocratic monarch was infamous for his capricious governance.
capricious.exampleZh: 在動盪的統治任期內，該專制君主以其反覆無常的治理風格而聲名狼藉。
capricious.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：capricious = fickle = mercurial！在 Sentence Equivalence 六選二中並列正解！

fickle.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Volatility
fickle.zh: 易變無常的、搖擺不定的
fickle.collocation: fickle public opinion (浮動易變的民意)
fickle.example: Politicians often discover that public adulation is utterly fickle and rapidly evaporates.
fickle.exampleZh: 政治人物常發現公眾的崇拜完全是變幻無常的，很快便煙消雲散。
fickle.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：fickle = capricious！修飾命運、人心與天候。

onerous.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Burden
onerous.zh: 繁重艱鉅的、沉重的、費力的
onerous.collocation: an onerous assignment (繁重艱辛的任務)
onerous.example: Translating ancient cuneiform clay tablets proved to be an extraordinarily onerous undertaking.
onerous.exampleZh: 翻譯殘破的古代楔形文字泥板被證明是一項極其繁重艱鉅的事業。
onerous.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：onerous = burdensome。拉丁語 onus (沉重負擔)。

burdensome.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Burden
burdensome.collocation: burdensome regulatory compliance (繁複沉重的法規遵循負擔)
burdensome.example: Small business entrepreneurs often lament the burdensome paperwork required by state agencies.
burdensome.exampleZh: 小型企業創業者經常抱怨政府機構所要求的繁複沉重的文書作業。
burdensome.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：burdensome = onerous。burden (負擔) + -some (充滿)。

pellucid.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Clarity
pellucid.zh: 清澈透亮的、清晰明瞭的
pellucid.example: The theoretical physicist was renowned for her pellucid exposition of complex gravitational theory.
pellucid.exampleZh: 該理論物理學家因其對複雜重力理論清晰透徹的闡述而享譽學界。
pellucid.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：pellucid = limpid。pel- (透徹) + luc (光亮/清晰)。

limpid.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Clarity
limpid.zh: 清澈透明的、明白通暢的
limpid.collocation: limpid stream / style (清澈的溪流/明白暢達的文風)
limpid.example: The mountain lake was so limpid that pebbles on the bedrock twelve meters below were visible.
limpid.exampleZh: 高山湖泊是如此清澈見底，以至於水下十二公尺岩床上的鵝卵石都清晰可辨。
limpid.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：limpid = pellucid。修飾文風「清澈無晦澀」。

mitigate.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Mitigation
mitigate.collocation: mitigate economic fallout (緩解經濟衝擊)
mitigate.example: Massive coastal mangrove reforestation projects are designed to mitigate hurricane storm surges.
mitigate.exampleZh: 大規模的沿海紅樹林造林計畫旨在緩解颶風引發的風暴潮。
mitigate.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生四姐妹】：mitigate = abate = attenuate = alleviate (減輕緩和)。等價題極高頻！

alleviate.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Mitigation
alleviate.collocation: alleviate poverty and chronic pain (緩解貧困與慢性疼痛)
alleviate.example: The humanitarian NGO provided emergency rations to alleviate acute famine in the drought sector.
alleviate.exampleZh: 人道救援非政府組織提供了緊急口糧以緩解乾旱災區嚴重的饑荒。
alleviate.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：alleviate = mitigate = abate。lev (輕，同 elevate) ➔ 使變輕。

ephemeral.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Transience
ephemeral.zh: 短暫的、轉瞬即逝的、朝生暮死的
ephemeral.example: Viral internet fame frequently proves to be ephemeral, vanishing as swiftly as it appeared.
ephemeral.exampleZh: 網路爆紅的知名度往往被證明是轉瞬即逝的，消逝得如同當初竄紅時那般迅速。
ephemeral.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生三胞胎】：ephemeral = transient = evanescent (短暫的)。

transient.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Transience
transient.zh: 短暫的、瞬息即逝的、過客的
transient.example: The psychologist observed that material wealth generates only a transient surge in happiness.
transient.exampleZh: 心理學家觀察到，物質財富帶來的幸福感往往只是轉瞬即逝的短暫提升。
transient.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：transient = ephemeral。trans- (通過) + i (走) ➔ 走過即逝。

laconic.category: GRE 核心同義詞群 / Rhetoric
laconic.zh: 簡潔的、說話言簡意賅的、寡言的
laconic.collocation: a laconic reply (言簡意賅的答覆)
laconic.example: Famous for his laconic temperament, the general responded to the enemy ultimatum with one word: 'Never.'
laconic.exampleZh: 將軍以其言簡意賅的寡言脾性聞名，他對敵軍的最後通牒只回敬了一個字：「休想。」
laconic.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：laconic = terse = curt。源自斯巴達拉哥尼亞 (Laconia) 人說話極簡之典故。

terse.category: GRE 核心同義詞群 / Rhetoric
terse.collocation: a terse statement (簡短扼要的聲明)
terse.example: The CEO issued a terse statement denying all allegations of insider stock trading.
terse.exampleZh: 執行長發表了一份措辭簡短生硬的聲明，全盤否認內線交易指控。
terse.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：terse = laconic。ters- (擦乾淨/去除多餘) ➔ 去除贅字。

specious.zh: 似是而非的、華而不實的、虛假的
specious.collocation: specious reasoning / argument (似是而非的論點)
specious.example: Under rigorous scrutiny, the lobbyist's plausible rhetoric was unmasked as entirely specious.
specious.exampleZh: 在嚴格審視之下，說客看似合理的修辭被揭穿完全是似是而非的詭辯。
specious.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：specious = spurious = fallacious。spec (看) ➔ 僅表面好看而已！

spurious.zh: 偽造的、虛假的、站不住腳的
spurious.collocation: spurious statistical correlation (虛假的統計相關性)
spurious.example: The scientific journal retracted the published paper after uncovering spurious experimental data.
spurious.exampleZh: 在揭發出偽造虛假的實驗數據後，該科學期刊撤回了已發表的論文。
spurious.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：spurious = specious = counterfeit (偽造虛假的)。

fastidious.category: GRE 核心同義詞群 / Character
fastidious.zh: 一絲不苟的、過分挑剔講究的
fastidious.collocation: fastidious attention to detail (對細節一絲不苟的講究)
fastidious.example: The master watchmaker was famously fastidious, examining each microscopic gear under high magnification.
fastidious.exampleZh: 鐘錶大師以極度一絲不苟聞名，在高倍放大鏡下一一檢視每顆微型齒輪。
fastidious.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：fastidious = meticulous = punctilious (嚴謹挑剔)。

meticulous.category: GRE 核心同義詞群 / Character
meticulous.zh: 極其嚴謹細緻的、一絲不苟的
meticulous.collocation: meticulous scientific documentation (細緻嚴謹的科學記錄)
meticulous.example: The conservator restored the Renaissance fresco with meticulous precision and immense patience.
meticulous.exampleZh: 古蹟修復專家以無比細緻嚴謹的精準度與無窮耐心，修復了文藝復興時期的濕壁畫。
meticulous.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：meticulous = fastidious。正向表「一絲不苟」，負向表「過分挑剔」。

reticent.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Demeanor
reticent.zh: 沉默寡言的、不願吐露的
reticent.collocation: reticent about personal matters (對個人私事守口如瓶寡言)
reticent.example: The witness remained reticent, answering the prosecutor's inquiries only with brief nods.
reticent.exampleZh: 證人始終保持沉默寡言，僅以微弱的點頭回應檢察官的訊問。
reticent.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：reticent = taciturn。tacit (心照不宣/安靜)。

taciturn.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Demeanor
taciturn.zh: 不苟言笑的、生性孤僻寡言的
taciturn.collocation: a taciturn loner (寡言孤僻之人)
taciturn.example: Growing up on a solitary mountain homestead made the woodsman notoriously taciturn.
taciturn.exampleZh: 在偏僻孤絕的高山農莊長大，讓這位伐木工人變得極其寡言孤僻。
taciturn.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：taciturn = reticent。修飾性格習慣性不講話。

apathy.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Emotion
apathy.example: Widespread civic apathy poses a grave danger to the vitality of democratic self-governance.
apathy.exampleZh: 普遍的公民冷漠對民主自治的蓬勃生機構成了嚴重威脅。
apathy.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：apathy = indifference。a- (無) + pathy (情感) ➔ 毫無感情。

indifference.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Emotion
indifference.collocation: treat with utter indifference (以徹底的漠不關心對待)
indifference.example: The monarch met the peasant petitions with callous indifference and increased levies.
indifference.exampleZh: 君主對農民的請願書表現出冷酷的漠不關心，反而加重了賦稅徵收。
indifference.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：indifference = apathy。in- (無) + difference (差別) ➔ 覺得都無所謂。

veneration.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Reverence
veneration.collocation: held in great veneration (備受尊崇景仰)
veneration.example: The indigenous community preserves deep veneration for the sacred cedar grove.
veneration.exampleZh: 該原住民族社群對這片神聖的雪松林懷抱著無比深沉的崇敬與景仰。
veneration.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：veneration = reverence = deification。Venus (愛與美之神) ➔ 崇拜膜拜。

reverence.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Reverence
reverence.collocation: profound reverence for nature (對大自然深沉的敬畏與崇拜)
reverence.example: The pilgrims entered the sanctuary in hushed reverence, lighting ceremonial candles.
reverence.exampleZh: 朝聖者滿懷虔敬的敬畏之情踏入聖所，點燃儀式專用的蠟燭。
reverence.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：reverence = veneration。revere (敬畏) ➔ 名詞 reverence。

bellicose.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Aggression
bellicose.example: The dictator delivered a bellicose speech threatening military invasion across the border.
bellicose.exampleZh: 該獨裁者發表了一場好戰的演說，揚言將對邊境彼端發動軍事入侵。
bellicose.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：bellicose = pugnacious = truculent。bell (戰爭，如 rebel 反叛)。

pugnacious.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Aggression
pugnacious.zh: 好鬥好吵架的、尋釁滋事的
pugnacious.collocation: a pugnacious politician (咄咄逼人好鬥的政客)
pugnacious.example: Known for his pugnacious posture during committee debates, he rarely conceded a point.
pugnacious.exampleZh: 因在委員會辯論中咄咄逼人、好鬥善辯聞名，他幾乎從不向對手做出讓步。
pugnacious.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：pugnacious = bellicose。pugn (拳頭，同 pugilist 拳擊手)。

innocuous.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Harmlessness
innocuous.zh: 無害的、良性的、無傷大雅的
innocuous.collocation: an innocuous remark (無傷大雅的隨興評論)
innocuous.example: What seemed like an innocuous question provoked unexpected outrage from the witness.
innocuous.exampleZh: 一句看似無傷大雅的隨興提問，卻引發了證人出乎意料的強烈憤怒。
innocuous.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：innocuous = benign = inoffensive。in- (無) + noc (傷害，同 noxious 有毒)。

benign.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Harmlessness
benign.zh: 溫和善良的、良性無害的 (反義詞 malignant 惡性的)
benign.collocation: a benign tumor / climate (良性腫瘤/溫和宜人的氣候)
benign.example: The biopsy confirmed that the detected tissue lump was completely benign.
benign.exampleZh: 組織切片檢查證實偵測到的組織腫塊完全是良性的。
benign.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：benign = innocuous。bene- (好/善，同 benefit)。

obviate.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Prevention
obviate.collocation: obviate the need for surgery (免除動手術的需要)
obviate.example: Early diagnostic detection often obviates the need for invasive chemotherapy treatments.
obviate.exampleZh: 早期診斷發現往往能免除病患進行侵入性化學治療的需要。
obviate.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：obviate = preclude。ob- (反對) + via (道路) ➔ 阻擋在半路免去麻煩。

loquacious.category: GRE 核心同義詞群 / Speech
loquacious.zh: 話多的、滔滔不絕的、喋喋不休的
loquacious.collocation: a loquacious dinner companion (話多健談的宴席同伴)
loquacious.example: A few glasses of vintage wine turned the normally reserved scholar into a loquacious conversationalist.
loquacious.exampleZh: 幾杯陳年佳釀讓原本矜持沉靜的學者頓時化身為滔滔不絕的健談者。
loquacious.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：loquacious = garrulous。loqu (說話，同 eloquent 雄辯的)。

garrulous.category: GRE 核心同義詞群 / Speech
garrulous.zh: 嘮叨絮聒的、多嘴多舌的
garrulous.collocation: a garrulous neighbor (愛嘮叨多話的鄰居)
garrulous.example: The driver proved so garrulous that passengers could scarcely read their newspapers in quiet.
garrulous.exampleZh: 司機是如此喋喋不休、熱衷嘮叨，乘客幾乎無法在安靜中閱讀報紙。
garrulous.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：garrulous = loquacious。garr- (喉嚨發聲，同 gargle 漱口)。

prosaic.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Dullness
prosaic.zh: 平淡無奇的、乏味的、散文般的
prosaic.collocation: prosaic day-to-day existence (平淡乏味的日常生活)
prosaic.example: Beyond the dazzling glamour of cinema lies the prosaic labor of logistical scheduling.
prosaic.exampleZh: 在電影耀眼炫目的光環背後，其實充斥著調度後勤排程等平淡乏味繁瑣的勞動。
prosaic.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：prosaic = pedestrian = mundane。prose (散文) ➔ 毫無詩意 ➔ 平淡無奇。

pedestrian.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Dullness
pedestrian.zh: 平淡沉悶的、乏味的；行人
pedestrian.collocation: a pedestrian plotline (陳腐沉悶的情節架構)
pedestrian.example: Critics condemned the television series for its pedestrian dialogue and cliché characters.
pedestrian.exampleZh: 影評人斥責該電視影集對白平淡沉悶、角色設定落入俗套陳腐。
pedestrian.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：pedestrian = prosaic。ped (腳步) ➔ 像走路般尋常平庸 ➔ 乏味的。

panacea.category: 句子等價孿生詞對 / Remedy
panacea.zh: 萬靈丹、百病良藥、萬全之策
panacea.collocation: no universal panacea (並非萬靈妙藥)
panacea.example: Technological innovation is beneficial, but it is not a panacea for deep structural poverty.
panacea.exampleZh: 科技創新大有裨益，但絕非根除深層結構性貧困問題的萬靈妙藥。
panacea.memoryTip: 【GRE 孿生同義詞】：panacea = cure-all。pan- (全/所有) + akos (治療) ➔ 包治百病之神藥。

assumption.zh: 未言明的前提假設 (若否定之，結論必崩潰)
assumption.collocation: underlying assumption (未言明的根本假設)
assumption.example: The marketing argument relies on the implicit assumption that consumer disposable income will not fall.
assumption.exampleZh: 該行銷論證仰賴於一個潛在未言明的前提假設：消費者的可支配所得不會下滑。
assumption.memoryTip: 【GMAT 命題密鑰】：否定測試法 (Negation Test)——若將該選項否定後，題幹結論直接崩解，則此選項必為 Necessary Assumption！

weaken.category: 批判推理削弱題型 / Weaken
weaken.zh: 削弱 (論證說服力、打破因果鏈)
weaken.collocation: seriously weaken the argument (嚴重削弱該論證)
weaken.example: Which of the following findings, if true, most seriously weakens the mayor's municipal economic claim?
weaken.exampleZh: 下列何項調查發現若為真，最嚴重削弱了市長對市政經濟前景的主張？
weaken.memoryTip: 【GMAT 削弱三大途徑】：1. 引入他因 (Alternative Cause)；2. 因果倒置 (Reverse Causality)；3. 割裂論據與結論之必然關聯。

strengthen.category: 批判推理加強題型 / Strengthen
strengthen.zh: 加強、支持 (結論成立的機率)
strengthen.collocation: strengthen the executive conclusion (加強經營團隊的結論)
strengthen.example: The economic consultant presented competitor cost data to strengthen the viability of the joint venture.
strengthen.exampleZh: 經濟顧問出示了競爭對手的成本數據，以加強該合資計畫的可行性。
strengthen.memoryTip: 【GMAT 加強三大途徑】：1. 排除反因/干擾變數；2. 證明無因則無果；3. 證實數據樣本具代表性。

evaluate.category: 評估與因果關係鏈 / Evaluation
evaluate.zh: 評估 (論證有效性之關鍵資訊)
evaluate.collocation: evaluate the validity of the argument (評估論證的有效性)
evaluate.example: Determining whether regional rivals can replicate the patented technology is critical to evaluate the proposal.
evaluate.exampleZh: 查明區域競爭對手是否能複製這項專利技術，對於評估該提案而言至關重要。
evaluate.memoryTip: 【GMAT 評估密鑰】：變異測試法 (Variance Test)——對選項回答 Yes 能加強結論，回答 No 則能削弱結論，即為正確 Evaluate 答案！

refute.collocation: refute the analyst's forecast (駁斥分析師的預測)
refute.example: The corporate treasurer presented audited financial statements to refute claims of imminent bankruptcy.
refute.exampleZh: 財務長出示經獨立審計的財務報表，駁斥了公司瀕臨破產的傳言。
refute.memoryTip: re- (反向) + fut (倒/擊碎，同 futile) ➔ 擊碎對方論點 ➔ 駁斥

premise.category: 批判邏輯與前提 / Argument Structure
premise.zh: 論據、前提 (題幹中明確陳述為事實的事實依據)
premise.example: The entire strategic plan is constructed upon the questionable premise that raw material prices will remain flat.
premise.exampleZh: 整個策略計畫皆建立在一個令人質疑的論據前提之上：原料價格將保持平穩不變。
premise.memoryTip: 【GMAT CR 結構分析】：Premise (已知客觀事實) + Assumption (隱含未言明前提) ➔ Conclusion (主觀推導結論)。

fallacy.collocation: commit a causal fallacy (犯下因果關係倒置或混淆的謬誤)
fallacy.example: Confusing correlation with causation is a classic logical fallacy often tested in GMAT reasoning.
fallacy.exampleZh: 將相關性誤認為因果關係，是 GMAT 邏輯批判推理中經常考查的經典邏輯謬誤。
fallacy.memoryTip: fall (欺騙/錯誤，同 false) + -acy ➔ 看似有理實則荒謬 ➔ 邏輯謬誤

causal.category: 評估與因果關係鏈 / Causality
causal.zh: 因果關係的 (非純粹相關)
causal.collocation: establish a direct causal link (確立直接的因果鏈結)
causal.example: Epidemiologists must establish a rigorous causal mechanism before asserting that chemical exposure triggers illness.
causal.exampleZh: 流行病學家在斷定化學物質暴露會引發疾病之前，必須先確立嚴謹的因果機制。
causal.memoryTip: 【GMAT 因果論證核心】：Correlation (相關) ≠ Causation (因果)！常考「倒果為因」或「第三外在因素干擾 (Confounding)」。

paradox.category: 矛盾解釋與推論 / Resolve the Paradox
paradox.zh: 看似矛盾的現象、悖論 (題幹要求解釋矛盾)
paradox.collocation: resolve the apparent paradox (解釋/化解看似矛盾之處)
paradox.example: The report presented a paradox: although average incomes rose, overall consumer discretionary spending fell.
paradox.exampleZh: 該報告揭示了一項看似矛盾的現象：儘管平均所得提升，但整體消費者的非必要支出卻下滑了。
paradox.memoryTip: 【GMAT 解題密鑰】：Explain/Resolve the Paradox 題型——尋求一個「新資訊」，能同時合理解釋 Fact A 與 Fact B 兩者何以同時並存！

extrapolate.category: 批判邏輯與前提 / Flaw in Reasoning
extrapolate.zh: 外推、推斷 (根據已知趨勢預測未知領域)
extrapolate.collocation: extrapolate future trends from past data (由歷史數據外推未來趨勢)
extrapolate.example: The executive warned that one cannot blindly extrapolate regional trial success to nationwide commercial viability.
extrapolate.exampleZh: 執行長警告，絕不能盲目地將單一區域試辦的成功，直接外推為在全國商業推廣的可行性。
extrapolate.memoryTip: extra- (向外) + pol (樞紐/軸心) + -ate ➔ 向外延伸推測 ➔ 外推推斷 (GMAT 常作為過度概括之錯誤邏輯選項)。

concomitant.category: 評估與因果關係鏈 / Causality
concomitant.zh: 伴隨發生的、相伴而生的 (非因果之伴生現象)
concomitant.collocation: concomitant economic expansion (伴隨發生的經濟擴張現象)
concomitant.example: The reduction in operational expenses was a concomitant benefit, not the primary driver of the software overhaul.
concomitant.exampleZh: 營運支出的減少只是一項伴隨而來的附帶好處，並非該軟體系統大改版的主要推動動機。
concomitant.memoryTip: con- (共同) + comit (伴侶/隨行) + -ant ➔ 只是結伴同行，並非起因！

boldface.zh: 黑體字 (GMAT 句子角色劃分題型)
boldface.collocation: the role of the boldface portion (黑體字部分在論證中所扮演的角色)
boldface.example: The first boldface statement introduces evidence supporting the conclusion that the second boldface statement refutes.
boldface.exampleZh: 第一段黑體字陳述引入了支持某結論的證據，而第二段黑體字陳述則旨在駁斥該結論。
boldface.memoryTip: 【GMAT CR 黑體字經典解法】：判斷每一段黑體字是「Premise (客觀論據)」還是「Conclusion (主觀推論)」？立場是站在作者方還是反對作者？

intermediate conclusion.chunk: in - ter - me - di - ate con - clu - sion
intermediate conclusion.zh: 中間次要結論 (既是上一層推論的結果，又是終極結論的前提)
intermediate conclusion.collocation: serves as an intermediate conclusion (作為過渡的中間結論)
intermediate conclusion.example: The analyst inferred that revenue would drop, which served as an intermediate conclusion supporting the budget cut.
intermediate conclusion.exampleZh: 分析師推斷營收將會下滑，這項中間結論進一步支持了最終削減預算的決策。
intermediate conclusion.memoryTip: 【GMAT CR 經典角色】：Sub-conclusion / Intermediate Conclusion——銜接基礎論據與主結論之樞紐！

counterargument.zh: 對立反駁論點、反面主張
counterargument.collocation: address potential counterarguments (回應潛在的反對主張)
counterargument.example: The proposal anticipated industry counterarguments by providing verified safety audit certifications.
counterargument.exampleZh: 該提案透過提供經認證的安全審計證明，預先回應了業界可能提出的反駁主張。
counterargument.memoryTip: counter (反對) + argument (論點) ➔ 對立方的論點

unwarranted.zh: 毫無根據的、缺乏正當理由的
unwarranted.collocation: an unwarranted leap in logic (邏輯上毫無根據的跳躍)
unwarranted.example: Critics pointed out that assuming all users would upgrade immediately was an unwarranted inference.
unwarranted.exampleZh: 評論家指出，逕自假設所有使用者都會立即升級，是一項毫無客觀根據的推論。
unwarranted.memoryTip: un- (無) + warrant (正當授權/保證) + -ed ➔ 缺乏保證的 ➔ 毫無根據的

confound.category: 評估與因果關係鏈 / Causality
confound.zh: 混淆、使混亂；干擾混入因果變數
confound.collocation: confound the experimental findings (干擾混淆實驗研究結果)
confound.example: Uncontrolled socioeconomic disparities confound the correlation between diet and cardiac health.
confound.exampleZh: 未受控制的社會經濟差距干擾混淆了飲食與心臟健康之間的相關性判定。
confound.memoryTip: con- (共同) + found (倒/融化) ➔ 倒在一起分不清 ➔ 混淆干擾變數

marginal.category: 商業決策與可行性 / Economics
marginal.zh: 邊際的、微不足道的、極微小的
marginal.collocation: marginal cost / benefit (邊際成本/邊際效益)
marginal.example: The marketing upgrade produced only marginal sales improvements despite enormous capital expenditure.
marginal.exampleZh: 儘管耗費了龐大的資本支出，該行銷升級僅帶來了微不足道的業績提升。
marginal.memoryTip: margin (頁邊空白) ➔ 處在最邊緣的 ➔ 微小的/邊際的

imperative.category: 商業決策與可行性 / Decision
imperative.zh: 迫切緊急的、勢在必行的；當務之急
imperative.collocation: a strategic imperative (策略上的當務之急)
imperative.example: Diversifying the semiconductor supplier network has become a national strategic imperative.
imperative.exampleZh: 半導體供應商網絡的多元化分散已成為國家層級勢在必行的策略當務之急。
imperative.memoryTip: imper (統治/命令，同 empire 帝國) ➔ 如帝王軍令般十萬火急 ➔ 勢在必行的

deter.category: 商業決策與可行性 / Strategy
deter.zh: 威懾阻止、使打消念頭 (搭配 from)
deter.collocation: deter hostile takeovers (威懾阻止惡意併購)
deter.example: Stiff regulatory financial penalties are instituted to deter corporations from dumping industrial pollutants.
deter.exampleZh: 制定高額監管罰款旨在威懾阻止企業傾倒工業廢棄物。
deter.memoryTip: de- (離開) + ter (恐懼，同 terror) ➔ 因恐懼代價而退縮 ➔ 威懾阻止

trade-off.category: 商業決策與可行性 / Economics
trade-off.zh: 權衡取捨、妥協折衷 (兩難之間的選擇)
trade-off.collocation: a trade-off between speed and accuracy (速度與精確度之間的權衡取捨)
trade-off.example: Engineers face an inevitable trade-off between lighter battery weight and extended driving range.
trade-off.exampleZh: 工程師面臨著電池輕量化與更長續航里程之間不可避免的權衡取捨。
trade-off.memoryTip: trade (交換) + off ➔ 放棄 A 以換取 B ➔ 權衡取捨

prohibitive.category: 商業決策與可行性 / Pricing
prohibitive.zh: (價格或費用) 高昂得令人望而卻步的
prohibitive.collocation: prohibitive installation costs (高昂令人卻步的安裝成本)
prohibitive.example: The cost of licensing the patented manufacturing process proved entirely prohibitive for the small startup.
prohibitive.exampleZh: 這項專利製造製程的授權費用過於高昂，這家小型新創公司完全負擔不起。
prohibitive.memoryTip: prohibit (禁止) + -ive ➔ 價格高到形同禁止購買 ➔ 昂貴得令人卻步的

discrepancy.category: 矛盾解釋與推論 / Resolve the Paradox
discrepancy.collocation: unexplained discrepancy in inventory figures (庫存數據中無法解釋的不符之處)
discrepancy.example: Auditors noticed a significant discrepancy between logged warehouse shipments and ledger receipts.
discrepancy.exampleZh: 審計員察覺到了倉庫出貨登記紀錄與總帳收據之間存在重大不符與矛盾之處。
discrepancy.memoryTip: dis- (分開) + crep (劈啪聲/裂痕) ➔ 數據出現裂痕對不上 ➔ 矛盾不一致
